journal_entries.text: Started using the app this week because Dr. Ortiz suggested it. I don't really know what to write. Work was fine I guess. I keep waking up at 4 and my brain starts listing everything I've done wrong.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Early-morning waking with ruminative self-criticism; ambivalent about journaling.

journal_entries.text: Everything feels like it takes three times the effort it should. I cancelled on Priya again tonight. I told her I had work but really I just couldn't face being 'on' for two hours. Then I sat on the couch scrolling until 1am which made me feel worse.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Cancelled social plans due to low energy; late-night scrolling worsened mood.

journal_entries.text: Session yesterday was about 'activity scheduling.' Picked a 20 minute walk in the mornings. Skeptical but I'll try.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Agreed to morning walks as behavioral activation; skeptical but willing.

journal_entries.text: My mom called and asked why I sound tired all the time. I said I was busy. I don't want her to worry but I also feel like a fraud pretending.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Concealing low mood from mother; feelings of inauthenticity.

journal_entries.text: Made it to the grocery store which felt like an accomplishment, which is kind of sad. Ate actual dinner instead of cereal.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Completed grocery shopping and cooked dinner; small sense of accomplishment tinged with self-judgment.

journal_entries.text: Walked twice this week. The second time I noticed the light through the trees on Maple and for like a minute I wasn't thinking about anything. That's something.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Completed two walks; brief moment of present-focused calm.

journal_entries.text: Lights out by 11:30 three nights in a row. Still waking up early but falling asleep is easier. Feel slightly less like a zombie at standups.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Improved sleep onset with consistent bedtime; daytime functioning improving.

journal_entries.text: Texted Priya and we got coffee Saturday. I almost bailed but didn't. It was really nice actually, she's going through stuff too.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Followed through on social plan despite urge to cancel; felt connected.

journal_entries.text: Noticed the 'I'm failing at everything' thought during a meeting and actually caught it. Wrote down evidence for and against like we practiced. It was mostly against.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Applied cognitive restructuring to an all-or-nothing thought at work.

journal_entries.text: Good week. Not great, but good. I cooked twice and walked five days. My manager said my report was solid.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Consistent routines and positive feedback at work; describes week as good.

journal_entries.text: Went to the farmers market with my sister. Bought way too many peaches. I laughed a lot today.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Enjoyable outing with sister; laughter and pleasure noted.

journal_entries.text: All hands meeting today. They announced a restructuring and my whole team is being cut. Severance is 8 weeks. I just sat in my car in the parking garage for 40 minutes. I don't know what I'm going to do about rent.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Laid off in company restructuring; acute distress and financial worry.

journal_entries.text: Can't stop doing the math on savings. Every time I close my eyes I see the number. Up until 3am again. Haven't walked since Thursday.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Financial rumination driving insomnia; behavioral activation lapsed.

journal_entries.text: Told my mom. She was supportive but then started listing jobs her friends' kids have and I just shut down.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Disclosed job loss to mother; felt overwhelmed by her problem-solving.

journal_entries.text: I keep thinking I peaked and this is the beginning of everything falling apart. Some nights I think everyone would be fine without me around. I'm not going to do anything, I just notice the thought is there more than it used to be.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Catastrophic thinking about the future; reports passive thoughts that others would be better off without her, denies intent.

journal_entries.text: Yesterday was my last day at work. Everyone was nice which almost made it worse. Today I slept 4 hours in the afternoon and now I'm wide awake.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Final day at job; daytime oversleeping disrupting night sleep.

journal_entries.text: Told Dr. Ortiz about the thoughts. We made a safety plan and she moved my session up. I was scared she'd overreact but she didn't. I feel a little less alone with it.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Disclosed passive ideation in session; collaborative safety plan created; felt supported.

journal_entries.text: Applied to two jobs. Walked around the block once. Small things. Priya brought over soup.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Resumed job applications and brief walk; received support from friend.

journal_entries.text: Back to walking most mornings. It's honestly the anchor of my day now that there's no commute. I put my phone in the kitchen at 11.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Re-established morning walks and phone-free bedtime routine.

journal_entries.text: Had a first round interview with a health tech company. I was nervous but it went well. Even if nothing comes of it I proved I can still do this.
journal_entries.ai_summary: First interview went well; regained sense of competence.

journal_entries.text: Caught myself catastrophizing about money again but I used the worry window thing and it actually stayed contained to 15 minutes.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Used scheduled worry time to contain financial rumination.

journal_entries.text: Jess's birthday. I didn't want to go, went anyway, stayed till 11. Danced a little. Who am I.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Attended friend's birthday despite reluctance; enjoyed it.

journal_entries.text: Second round interview Thursday. Sleeping 7 hours most nights. I don't feel 'fixed' but I feel like myself more days than not.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Advancing in interview process; sleep consolidated; feels more like herself.

journal_entries.text: Got an offer! Starting in three weeks. I cried in the kitchen and then called my mom. Want to keep the walks going when I start.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Received job offer; plans to maintain routines after starting work.

voice_notes.transcript: Okay, um, first voice note. I'm on the train. I feel kind of heavy today. Not anything specific, just heavy. Yeah. That's it.
I did the walk this morning. It was raining a little and I almost didn't go. Glad I did I guess. Still tired.
voice_notes.ai_summary: Completed walk despite rain; still fatigued.

voice_notes.transcript: Just got out of a meeting where I felt totally stupid. My chest is tight. I'm going to try the naming-the-feeling thing. Embarrassed. Anxious. Okay, a little better.
voice_notes.ai_summary: Work-triggered shame and anxiety; used affect labeling with some relief.

voice_notes.transcript: Sunday reset. I meal prepped, which I haven't done in months. Feeling... proud? Weird word for chicken and rice.
Saw my sister today. We walked by the river. It felt normal. Like old me.
voice_notes.ai_summary: Pleasant time with sister; sense of returning to self.

voice_notes.transcript: I can't, I can't really talk right now. They cut the whole team. I just wanted to say it out loud to something.
It's 3am. I can't sleep. Everything just keeps looping. I don't know why I'm recording this.
Didn't really get out of bed today. Ordered food. I know I should walk, I just... can't make my legs do it.
voice_notes.ai_summary: Low activation; recognizes but cannot act on walking goal.

voice_notes.transcript: Went around the block. Talked to Priya for an hour. Session tomorrow. Feeling a tiny bit more solid.
voice_notes.ai_summary: Brief walk and supportive call; slightly more grounded.

voice_notes.transcript: Interview prep. Nervous but in a normal way, not the drowning way. That distinction feels important.
voice_notes.ai_summary: Normal anticipatory anxiety, distinguished from overwhelm.

voice_notes.transcript: Morning walk, sun's out. Saw that same light on Maple Street. Remember noticing it in July? I feel a lot different now.
voice_notes.ai_summary: Reflects on progress since July during walk.

voice_notes.transcript: Offer accepted! Okay. I want to remember this feeling. And remember that the bad weeks ended.
voice_notes.ai_summary: Accepted job offer; wants to remember that hard weeks pass.

definitions.trigger: When I notice a surge of shame or anxiety
